Team —

Quick ask: Nimbus Health is running a time-boxed external pilot starting tomorrow (29th) through Jan 10 and they need predictable inference capacity for their nightly batch scoring and daytime demo windows. Sales dropped the pilot into my queue late Friday; Karthik is copied here for context.

Summary of the ask:
- Reservation: reserve a 4-GPU slice in the us-west dedicated pool (GPUs: A10G equiv) from 2026-12-29 00:00 to 2027-01-10 23:59 PST.
- Autoscale exception: allow burst to 6 GPUs for short windows (max 2 hours/day) for scheduled demo runs at 10am PST on weekdays.
- Latency/throughput target: demo responses <500ms p95 for single-turn prompts, batch scoring throughput ~1200 reqs/hour during nightly jobs.
- Fallback: if reservation cannot be fully honored, want a fallback to hosted with model variant that is quantized (quality delta acceptable).

Attached is the pilot capacity proposal from Nimbus (nimbus_capacity_proposal_v2.pdf) and our suggested SLA table.

Can Ops/Infra confirm whether we can make a temporary carve and exception for autoscale, and what the approval path is? If procurement/legal needs to sign anything for a short-term reserved carve, flag it here. Goal is minimal friction so pilot doesn't slip into mid-Jan.

Thanks —
Diego

3) Diego/Marissa: confirm whether the fallback to quantized hosted variant is acceptable to the customer as an automatic failover.
